data.text: Situated in Sector 24, DLF Phase-3, Gurugram, The VIDYA School is built across a modern, architecturally designed, and eco-friendly campus. Our physical facilities are carefully engineered to foster an inspiring, safe, and holistic environment for over 1,200 students.

data.label: Student Capacity
data.subtext: 30+ Smart Classrooms, 100% Solar-Powered, DLF Phase-3 Gurugram

items.title: Smart Classrooms
items.description: Spacious, well-ventilated classrooms fitted with interactive smart boards, high-speed audio-visual equipment, and ergonomic seating.

items.title: Advanced Science & STEM Labs
items.description: Fully equipped Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, and Robotics laboratories supporting practical inquiry.

items.title: Sports & Recreation Fields
items.description: Multi-sport outdoor grounds, basketball court, badminton facilities, athletics tracks, and indoor recreation zones.

items.title: Digital Library & Reading Hub
items.description: Over 10,000 literary volumes, reference encyclopedias, journals, and dedicated digital terminals for student research.

items.title: Green Energy & Clean Water
items.description: Rooftop solar power generation plant, rainwater harvesting systems, and reverse osmosis (RO) purified drinking water stations.

items.title: Comprehensive Campus Security
items.description: 24/7 CCTV surveillance, fire prevention and safety certification, trained security personnel, and full emergency medical infirmary.
